notes: Identity: the supplied text is a complete 12-page primary empirical report, not an abstract or secondary account. Its title, five authors (Jay Belsky, Sara R. Jaffee, Avshalom Caspi, Terrie Moffitt, Phil A. Silva), journal/year/volume/pages match the neutral original reference. The cache metadata identifies DOI 10.1037/0893-3200.17.4.460; the article body does not independently print the DOI. No network identity verification performed. No PDF was supplied, so layout could not be rendered. Only n_o and es_value_o are assigned; all other fields/sides are placeholders. Target ambiguity: Table 1 Model 4 reports Negative emotionality -.10** for mother–child affectional solidarity and .01 for father–child affectional solidarity. The same table defines **p < .01 for the mother coefficient; no exact p or explicit bound accompanies the unstarred father coefficient. These are candidates only, not selected target values. Table 2 p. 8 additionally reports .03 for each parent functional–associational outcome, outside the supplied p. 7 locator. The source labels Table 1 entries Regression Coefficient but does not explicitly establish standardised beta identity; no conversion or standardisation is assumed. The supplied description does not identify mother versus father or equate family satisfaction to a particular dyadic composite. Therefore target_match remains null, value fields null and confidence false. N review: Method participation counts are not documented critical-model analytic Ns. Counts in the pp. 7–8 cumulative normative-transition analysis pertain to a different analysis (Table 3), and are not used for Table 1. No N was derived from degrees of freedom or summed across parents; calculation: none.
